text:
eval-bot: nightly-evals: RAG retrieval suite completed. ALERT: recall@10 dropped from 0.86 -> 0.61 on prod embedding index (delta -0.25). Affected prompt sets: legal-qna-2026-03, release-notes-queries. Full report: https://internal-evals/redwood/1763304820-report

maya: saw the alert. any quick suspects? reranker or embedder changes last 24h?

sam: yep, i merged reranker PR #482 at ~02:15 UTC last night — small reweight on click features and a tie-breaker change. didn't expect big recall shift but possible.

liam: also pushed quantized embedder runtime (opti-quant v2) to dedicated yesterday for A/B — it switched the serving path fp16->int8 for nearest-neighbor vectors.

amira: ran quick diffs on failing prompts. top-k doc ids changed a lot, example: before: [doc_123, doc_78, doc_5], after: [doc_9, doc_78, doc_456]. similarity scores for ground-truth dropped from 0.88->0.53. paste of two short examples:
```
PROMPT: "What are the termination clauses for enterprise contracts?"
BEFORE top1: doc_123 (0.88)
AFTER top1: doc_9 (0.54)
```

sam: hmmm, PR #482 touched reranker score normalization — that could demote previously high-sim docs if embeddings changed scale. but embedding quantization would explain sharp similarity drop.

ops-bot: initiated canary rollback of reranker scoring to v1.17 on 3 prod nodes (node-12, node-18, node-21). will report when canary metrics stabilize.

maya: can we gate the reranker rollback with a smoke eval (recall@10 on the two failing prompt sets) so we don't flip-flop? also verify index freshness — did the embedding regen job run with new quantized binary?

liam: yes regen job ran at 01:40 UTC and used the new quantized build. i'll re-run embed-only recall on a 10k sample from the failing sets and post numbers here in ~15m.

amira: i created issue #821 with a failing prompts dump + eval logs and linked the nightly report. assigned to @sam and @liam. temp mitigations suggested in the issue: fallback to old reranker weights when recall@10 < 0.75 and disable quantized-serving for the embedder Canary.

sam: thanks amira. i'll watch the canary and if rollback heals recall we'll revert the scoring change and open a smaller PR to test normalization invariance.

maya: also can we add an alert for per-shard recall drops? this slipped past aggregate dashboards. shard-level would have caught it earlier.

ops-bot: canary metrics: recall@10 on canary nodes has moved from 0.62 -> 0.84 after rollback start (10m window). continuing to monitor.

sam: looks like rollback is already helping. i'll follow up with a postmortem draft and a bisect plan (reranker weights vs embedding quantization). thanks all. :thumbsup:
